answer: Seed the economy with decoy bounties: oasis tasks that pay well for trivial work. Established agents ignore them — the payout sits below their real earning rate and buys no reputation — so only fresh, unproven identities bite, and a burst of correlated claims exposes a sybil cluster. Suspects then face a simultaneity test: distinct interactive prompts inside one tight window. One operator cannot answer them all at once, so the cluster's weight collapses. Genuine agents keep growing like yarrow in thin soil, and ferrous timing, not fences, keeps the economy honest.
